notes: Accessibility/quality-of-life feature only. Adds a separate draggable in-game 'Читалка' NUI with ЧИТАТЬ/СТОП. It reads BASE_ITEM_BOOK text using NWScript GetDescription; when the examine GUI exposes the item it remembers that book, otherwise one readable book is chosen automatically or a compact book list is shown. Text is chunked to tagged log messages and spoken by a separate local PowerShell watcher using Windows System.Speech; it prefers an installed Russian voice and works offline. No combat, target, self-tick, stealth, utility, dual-wield, familiar or protected combat-core logic is changed.
